dom.text: Belzenlok is an elder demon freed from the Abyss when the Cabal tried to summon Kuberr, and in Dominaria he rules as the Demonlord, with the Cabal hailing him as Evincar of the Stronghold and Eternal Patriarch.
After the Mending he maims the cabalists who summoned him, restores the Cabal's power and moves its capital to the Stronghold of Urborg, expanding across Dominaria as a death cult.

Liliana Vess admits that Belzenlok, her last demon, is on Dominaria, and she and Gideon set out to kill him, while she learns that he has made her brother Josu his lich general to leave her too weak to use the Chain Veil against him.
Jhoira offers the Weatherlight's help, and in the attack on the Stronghold, Belzenlok knocks Gideon down, but the Blackblade pierces his thigh and Liliana seizes it, drains his life and kills him.
